fact: The Senate unanimously adopted on 16 June 2025 a bill, described by the source as a cybersecurity bill, ratifying Ordinance No. 2024-950 and updating the 2017 electronic-exchanges ordinance; no entry into force is stated.

The national information-security agency ANSSI's 2024 report, presented on 22 May 2025, says its cybercrime platform received and handled 12,100 files in 2024, up from 8,132 the year before, including fraudulent access to information systems and online fraud; the report as relayed does not name the law they were handled under.
